analysis.is_complaint_reason: Customer expressed dissatisfaction that the app repeatedly crashes at login, causing her to be unable to pay rent on time and to travel to a branch 40 minutes away (material inconvenience and possible financial loss under CH-1). Fourth contact about the same issue.
analysis.summary: Customer reports the Harbourline app has crashed at every login attempt for about three weeks. Contact centre advised reinstalling the app (29 Sep) and clearing the cache (6 Oct); the issue continued after reinstall on 13 Oct, when an IT ticket was noted but it is unclear whether it was sent. This is the customer's fourth call about the issue. She says she could not pay her rent on time and had to travel to a branch 40 minutes away. She wants the app fixed and compensation for the inconvenience. Device recorded as Android, app version unknown. No vulnerability indicators were noted on 20 Oct. No evidence is listed on file.

timeline.event: Customer called about app login crash; agent advised reinstalling the app.
Customer called again; app still crashing. Agent advised clearing the cache.
Customer called again; app still crashing after reinstall. IT ticket raised, but agent unsure whether it was sent.
Complaint logged by complaints handler. Customer reports she could not pay rent on time and travelled to a branch 40 minutes away.

analysis.severity_reason: Repeated service failure: the customer has contacted the bank four times about the same issue (CH-6). Possible financial impact from the missed rent payment is not yet quantified, so it is not assessed as High at this stage.

vulnerability.suggested_support: No indicators recorded. Confirm at contact whether the customer needs any support, given the missed rent payment and repeated contact (VUL-2).

analysis.routing_reason: A systems or app failure that needs technical investigation is routed to Digital Operations (ESC-1). The IT ticket status needs confirming first.

policy_citations.quote: A systems or app failure that needs technical investigation → *Digital Operations*.
policy_citations.how_it_applies: The login crash is a app failure that requires technical investigation, so the case goes to Digital Operations.

policy_citations.quote: A complaint is any expression of dissatisfaction, oral or written, about the bank's products, services or staff, where the customer alleges they have suffered (or may suffer) financial loss, material distress or material inconvenience.
policy_citations.how_it_applies: The customer is dissatisfied with the app and reports material inconvenience and a missed rent payment, so this is a complaint.
The primary root cause is the app crashing at login.

analysis.suggested_next_step: Confirm the IT ticket status and reference, then hand over to Digital Operations within 2 business days (ESC-2). Ask the customer sensitively about support needs (VUL-2). Check whether other customers report the same login crash, as this may be a systemic issue. Compensation is for the handler to decide under CH-8 and RED.
